meta.description: How Teknoppy turned an outdated site into a calm, mobile-first, conversion-focused website for Greens Ayurveda, a Calicut Ayurvedic hospital and academy serving patients in India and abroad.

meta.value: UI/UX Design, Website Development, Content Architecture, Local & Organic SEO

paragraphs.text: Greens Ayurveda is an Ayurvedic hospital and international academy based in Azhiyur, Calicut, Kerala. It offers Panchakarma therapies and practitioner training to patients and medical trainees across India and abroad.

items.title: An outdated digital presence
items.text: The existing website did not reflect the quality of the care Greens Ayurveda provides, so first-time visitors had little reason to trust it or to enquire.

items.title: Low discovery for specialised therapies
items.text: Panchakarma and treatment searches from India and overseas were not leading visitors to the site, limiting how many people could find the hospital and academy.

items.title: No clear path from interest to enquiry
items.text: Treatments, programmes and practitioners were not organised so a visitor could quickly find what they needed and take the next step.

paragraphs.text: Teknoppy's goal was to transform an outdated digital presence into a credible, conversion-focused platform that serves two audiences at once — patients looking for authentic Ayurvedic treatment and professionals looking for practitioner training — wherever in the world they are searching from.

sections.caption: greensayurveda.com — homepage as it appears today.

sections.h2: A comprehensive range of services offered by Teknoppy and their outcomes

items.title: UI/UX design
items.text: A calm, mobile-first layout with serene imagery that matches the healing ethos of the brand and works comfortably on a phone.

items.title: Content architecture
items.text: Treatment pages, programme listings, practitioner profiles, FAQs and a structured enquiry flow, so visitors can find the right treatment or course quickly.

items.title: Local and organic SEO
items.text: Targeted content for Ayurvedic treatment in Kerala and a Panchakarma centre in Calicut, supported by schema markup.

items.title: Conversion flow
items.text: Prominent appointment calls to action, enquiry forms and WhatsApp integration to capture enquiries, including from international visitors.

sections.h2: Greens Ayurveda's Outcome After Teknoppy's Work

items.title: More enquiries, notably from abroad
items.text: A measurable rise in enquiries, particularly from international visitors.

items.title: Stronger engagement
items.text: Visitors spend more time on the page and bounce less.

items.title: Steady organic growth
items.text: Growing organic visibility for relevant wellness and treatment keywords.

paragraphs.text: "Mr. Sanal is exceptionally supportive and customer-friendly. I have worked with many IT teams, but I am 100% happy with Teknoppy. No doubt, I recommend them with 100% satisfaction." — Dr. Asghar, CEO, Greens Ayurveda, Calicut

items.q: What was the main goal of the Greens Ayurveda project?
items.a: To replace an outdated website with a credible, conversion-focused platform that helps patients and medical trainees in India and abroad find Greens Ayurveda and get in touch.

items.q: What did Teknoppy deliver for Greens Ayurveda?
items.a: A calm, mobile-first website design, treatment and programme content architecture, local and organic SEO with schema markup, and a conversion flow built around appointment calls to action, enquiry forms and WhatsApp.

items.q: Who is the website built for?
items.a: Two audiences: patients seeking Panchakarma and other Ayurvedic treatments, and practitioners and medical trainees looking for the academy's training programmes.
